test_alternator_resets_on_restart: test the alternator.Alternator class resets state correctly when continuing from a saved state across episodes
test_puppeteers_goals_from_observations: test the puppeteers.goals_from_observations function extracts goals from a puppeteer over a sequence of observations
test_alternator_parameterized_steps: test the alternator.Alternator class with multiple steps_per_goal values using parameterized test cases
test_alternator_circular_goal_sequence: test the alternator.Alternator class repeats the goal sequence in a circular manner across multiple episodes
